notes: Text normalisation: PDF ligature glyphs (ﬁ ﬂ ﬃ ﬀ) rewritten as plain letters; words hyphenated across wrapped table lines re-joined (e.g. 'Kavithendral kalyana sund-haram' -> 'sundharam', 'Thiruveng-adam'); run-together health designations spaced ('ZonalHealthOfficer' -> 'Zonal Health Officer'); depths printed '2 .5 Feet' and '1 .5 Feet' written as '2.5 Feet' / '1.5 Feet'. Spellings otherwise as printed.
SWM Assistant Executive Engineer phone is printed with a space as '72996 08181'; recorded digits-only as 7299608181.
The AEE U-5 jurisdiction is printed '(18, 20, 21 & 22 )' - ward 19 is not listed under any AEE unit. Lighting contacts cover '15 to 21'; ward 22 is not covered by the lighting table.

Inundation table (pages 239-243, 84 rows) is the heavy-rain list; it gives max depth and days to drain but NO pump or pump-location columns. Its Disposal Point column uses merged cells spanning several rows; each row was assigned the disposal point whose text sits vertically within that row group. These assignments are inferred from layout and should be spot-checked against the PDF, especially rows 1-2, 4-5, 8-10, 12-15, 18-19, 21-23, 24-25, 28-30, 31-33, 37-40, 41-42, 43, 44-48, 50-56, 57-60, 61-64, 65-72, 75-78, 79-81, 82-84.
Water stagnation: mild rainfall list printed as 'Nil'; no sewer-block stagnation ('There are no sewer block in Manali'). Heavy-rain list is recorded only in inundation_streets.

Relief centres: intro (page 247) says 14 centres with total capacity 3040, but the 14 printed capacities sum to 3440. The relief-shelter map (page 252) names R1 (ward 15) as 'Edayanchavadi School' whereas the table names the ward 15 centre 'Jai Gopal Gardia Higher Secondary School'. Rows 1-12 printed Cooking Yes / Drinking water Yes / Toilets No; rows 13-14 printed No / Yes / Yes.

Its Assistant Revenue Officer and Asst. Exe. Engineer numbers are printed swapped relative to every other row (ARO 9445190105, AEE 9445190082); kept as printed.

Relief centre contact roles: Sanitary Inspector = Sanitation, Medicine & Drinking water; Junior/Assistant Engineer = Evacuation; Assistant Revenue Officer = Food; Asst. Exe. Engineer = Relief Materials.

Evacuation row 12 (ward 20, 42 persons) lists streets as 'Govt. High school at Padasalai street' and relief centre 'Govt. High School , Mathur' - looks transposed in the source; kept as printed. Total evacuated 1565.
